card.title: PS4 Southbridge Diagnosis via Standby Current

claims.statement: If the console stays at 99mA current draw with no boot, the Southbridge is likely faulty.
claims.evidence: Current draw observation during standby boot sequence.
claims.quote: If it stays at 99mA with no boot it could mean that the southbridge is bad. Check the 32Khz crystal if it oscillates. If the 32Khz signal is missing, then replace the southbridge

claims.statement: If the console stays at 7mA current draw, the Southbridge may be failing to send a control signal to the transistor.
claims.evidence: Current draw observation during standby boot sequence.
claims.quote: If it stays at 7mA with no boot it could mean that the southbridge is not working or sending a control signal to the transistor

procedure: Connect PIN 1 and 4 of the power supply connector to a +5V power supply.
Monitor current draw during the boot sequence.
Check for 32kHz oscillation on the crystal if current is stuck at 99mA.
card.caveats: Current draw values are specific to the standby boot sequence.
